Description: Susceptible people are exposed to contaminated water and become infected.
Infectious people recover and become immune.
Infectious people contaminate the water supply by shedding bacteria.

Name: γ
Description: Per capita recovery rate, the reciprocal of the duration of cholera infection (2.9 to 14 days).

Name: δ
Description: Cholera decay rate in the water reservoir, the reciprocal of the cholera life span in water (3 to 41 days).

Name: ξ
Description: Rate of water contamination by humans.

Name: κ
Description: Concentration of cholera that yields a 50% chance of infection.
